message.content:
The most celebrated sculpture of the 19th century is generally considered to be **“The Kiss” (Le Baiser) by Auguste Rodin** (1889).  
Rodin’s marble pair, depicting an intimate embrace, became an icon of modern sculpture and was widely reproduced and exhibited throughout Europe and the United States. It captured the era’s fascination with realism, emotion, and the human form, and it remains one of the most recognizable works of art from that period.
